text: On the authority of Ali, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said when Fatima - may God be pleased with her - asked him for a servant: Shall I not guide you to what is better for you than a servant? When you go to bed, or take your rest, say “Allahu Akbar” thirty-four times, “Subhan Allah” thirty-three times, and “Al-Hamdu” thirty-three times. This is better for you than a servant
